Senses.Explanation: The minute jiaoming insect is an extremely small creature. In the Collected Guidelines of the Lineage Masters, Yuejiang Yin makes the scale explicit by saying that it builds its nest on a mosquito's eyelash, hence the descriptive alternate “mosquito-eyelash insect.” Chan verses and addresses repeatedly reverse that scale: Dahui Zonggao puts a giant turtle inside its eye; Mengshan Yi has it drain the ocean; Liao'an Qingyu is asked about its swallowing a tiger; Yinshan Can puts a night market in its eye; and Zhongfang Tianlun says it swallows five Mount Sumerus. In the Surviving Draft of the Continued Lamp, Gaofeng Yuanmiao says that such an insect has blundered into his sky-spanning net; the line occurs inside Duanya Liaoyi's biography because Gaofeng is speaking about Duanya. These are distinct large-in-small actions and comparisons involving the same tiny creature, not evidence that the headword itself means the cosmos or carries one fixed interpretation. The headword is attested in the corpus.
